records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: game environment panorama. Create one landscape 3:2 illustrated background for CRY WOLF, a tender nonviolent fable. A small storybook village with rounded cream cottages and warm brass windows at far left, a simple wooden watchtower with a hanging lantern left of center, an unambiguous winding patrol path and white boundary stones across the lower half, a navy forest of stylized firs on the right, low eastern hills in the distance. Large uncluttered midnight navy sky in upper half, NO MOON (it is a separate game layer). Leave center foreground open for waist-up character sprites. Elegant hand-painted gouache / cut paper picture-book shapes, restrained paper grain, simple flat shapes and one shadow plane, clean readable silhouette, gentle atmospheric depth. Palette midnight navy #19283F, blue slate, moon cream #F4EAD9, muted sage, tiny brass lamps. Whimsical, wistful, inviting, not dark horror. No characters, no people, no creatures, no lettering, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Landscape aspect 3:2. Intended destination environment-village-tower.png.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent game character portrait. Create original village mayor for CRY WOLF, a gentle nonviolent fable. A kindly elderly anthropomorphic sheep, rounded cream wool head and short floppy sheep ears, small round brass spectacles, warm brown eyes and worried-but-listening eyebrows, charcoal muzzle, simple navy long waistcoat over cream shirt, muted brown scarf. Holding an old folded cream map with simple lines and no text, one hand open in a thoughtful welcoming gesture. Full body centered with generous transparent margin, all ears and feet visible, slight three-quarter turn left. Hand-painted picture-book gouache plus clean navy ink outlines, large simple color shapes, restrained paper grain and one shadow plane. Palette navy #19283F, moon cream #F4EAD9, taupe wool, tiny brass accents. Memorable soft silhouette. Wise ordinary community caretaker, not regal, not a villain. No weapons, no staff, no crown, no text, no watermark. Actual transparent background, no scenery and no floor shadow. Match a rabbit postman companion with sage cape in the same illustrated animal fable.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: game expression atlas, 2 columns x 2 rows. EDIT the provided Bell four-expression sheet into FOUR NEW emotional expressions while preserving the SAME character identity, black/cream forelock pattern, viewer-left folded border collie ear, amber eyes, navy cape, cream shirt, black gloves, collar bell, brass lantern and fluffy tail. Keep exact same 2x2 layout, same scale, bust to upper thighs, each cell with transparent padding and no neighboring overlap, transparent background. TOP LEFT: startled with wide eyes, slightly open mouth, upright ear perking, lantern clasped tightly. TOP RIGHT: embarrassed apology, gaze down, shoulders a little lower, folded ear droops, mouth worried. BOTTOM LEFT: relief, small warm closed-eye smile, shoulders softened. BOTTOM RIGHT: quiet courage, facing slightly right with a warm determined smile, one hand gently lifted by chest, other holding lantern. This is still Bell, not a redesigned person. Clean navy line work, simple one-plane cel shading, very restrained illustrated-fable paper texture. Do not flip horizontally. Do not add text, labels, scenery, boxes, borders, or marks. Make the expressions visibly distinct at mobile size, innocent age-appropriate emotional acting. Preserve genuine alpha transparency.
